title: Tighter database health gating
points: Reduced noisy database-health warnings by keeping broad ratio outlier diagnostics in pipeline artifacts while publishing only actionable unit/scale suspects as user-visible cautions.
Ratios are now rebuilt only from source statement rows that passed deterministic QC, so rows already marked with unit or scale concerns do not generate misleading derived ratios.
SCS P/E and dividend-yield comparisons now publish as yellow cautions rather than red blockers; red health cells are reserved for hard statement QC failures.

Source-filing subtotal mismatches now preserve the PDF-reported number while surfacing a scoped caution that says the source filing may have an internal arithmetic, reclassification, omitted-line, or unlabelled-subtotal issue.
